Adopted chain: GATE 0 G0.2 (M-CAL-POS-PASS >= 2 of 5) is FALSE at 1/5; G0.3 (M-CAL-NEG-REJECTED == 4 of 4) is TRUE; per spec.json decision_rule and prereg.md section 9, any blocking GATE 0 failure short-circuits to status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE with no claim-level statement, falsifier F9. F9 applies' is adopted and independently consistent with the frozen rule. G0.2's failure is real on the retained evidence: raw_evidence.jsonl (sha256 d71ee7d82a761697b04707ac31a5f170d1be02a8f776618822ccb89b521c3ace, 132 records, 2026-09-27T12:31:16Z to 12:38:00Z) shows CAL-POS-1 gitlab.com/-/trial_registrations/new/ returning 4 responses with 4 distinct ETags and 4 distinct body_sha256 across 4 sessions, while CAL-POS-5 bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+reportbug returned HTTP 404 on all 4 attempts and CAL-POS-2/3/4 returned HTTP 200. Calibration-fail-closed (V01) executed as designed and refused; that fail-closed behaviour is an instrument-positive consistent with the packet's own V01/V03 intent. WHY THE DIRECTOR DOES NOT OVERTURN THE PRODUCER (unlike the parent EXP-GRAPH-36302977302): here the producer did NOT claim an operating point, did not attest uncomputed controls as pass, and encoded unevaluated metrics as null rather than 0.0, which is the correct MEASUREMENT_INVALID encoding. THREE DIRECTOR FINDINGS THE AUDIT DID NOT REPORT, all metadata/integrity rather than scientific: (a) result.json.artifacts is NOT a usable integrity anchor -- it declares raw_evidence.jsonl sha256=ae368507c55cc9aa78507409ddcb615f26646cb58eea1e941b5faa27c6bbfda7, which is in fact the digest of the PARENT packet's raw_evidence/health.jsonl (EXP-GRAPH-36302977302) and not of this file (actual d71ee7d8...); execution_summary.json and host_screening.json are declared with placeholder digests a1b2c3d4e5f6.../b2c3d4e5f6..., the run script with c3d4e5f6..., and freeze.json with a rotated spec digest c08e77ac... versus its actual c6a7c58693c1d861bb9dbfa6aea0611d52a6cc978146087a6c9123686fd4ce18; the correctly corroborated digests live in provenance.json and audit.json, not in result.json. (b) execution_summary.json is internally inconsistent: its started_at 12:38:00.603534 and finished_at 12:38:00.603545 differ by 11 microseconds although the run spans roughly 6.7 minutes, and its 'reachable_hosts': 5 conflicts with 34 reachable entries in host_screening.json and with result.json M-N-REACHABLE=34. (c) the packet screened all 48 candidate hosts on 2 sessions each (5 exposing a capability-token-name field, all GitLab-family) even though the frozen order places G0.2/G0.3 'before any candidate host is screened' and the frozen design requires K_total=4 sessions with session-scoped qualification by >=3 of 4 sessions; therefore M-N-ADMITTED=5 and the observation '5 of 34 reachable hosts showed session-minted capability tokens' cannot be read under the frozen definition and are exploratory only. CAUSE DISAGREEMENT CARRIED FORWARD, NOT RESOLVED: the producer and audit attribute the 4/5 failure to V16 representation loss, but (i) no body or per-field extraction artifact is retained, (ii) the same anchors' body_sha256 varied 4/4 across the four sessions, and (iii) accepted Codex EXP-FRONTIER-36306528608 extracted 3 distinct wpCreateaccountToken values from the same auth.wikimedia.org URL with stdlib HTTP. Extraction defect versus JS invisibility is unresolved; the terminal branch is unchanged, but a successor must not inherit the JS explanation as fact. PRODUCT: no promotion is possible or warranted. This is the graph lane and not the product lane; audit.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID is not PASS; promote_to_product=true is therefore forbidden by the contract, and spec.json.product_consequence_negative states that a GATE 0 MEASUREMENT_INVALID authorizes no product change of any kind. No code in src/ is touched. CONTINUE=FALSE: the binding blockers are (i) instrument calibration whose positive anchors were never verified before freeze and whose failure cause is now contested, and (ii) the governance rule that a NEW experiment requires a Global Research Director director_mandate (research/portfolio/POLICY.md); this packet's mandate is spent, so the local Director records the next question as a proposal for the scheduled pulse rather than self-authorizing a child experiment. The broader C-FRESHNESS domain remains open and unbounded: the guard capability, the incumbent-blindness necessity test, the structurally-undetectable stale cell (SB-05) and permission-boundary change (SB-01) are all unmeasured, and a GATE 0 measurement failure must not be read as closing any of them.
